**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Separate playback-rate and processing refresh flags**

When the playback-rate field has unapplied focused input and an Undo/Redo or another command changes only clip processing, this combined flag forces `numericField(clipRate_, ...)` during `refresh` and discards the user's rate entry even though the stored rate did not change. The reverse also occurs for focused gain/fade inputs when only the rate changes. Track rate and processing changes separately so unrelated model publications preserve the focused field as intended.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
